thread:
Ava: Flagging an analytics discrepancy: Console 'Save' actions are inflating team saved-query quotas because quick session snapshots are counted as persistent saves. We should split types.
Liam: Can we add a `kind` on saved_queries: `snapshot` vs `library`? Quotas should only count `library`.
Priya: UX: make save a tiny dropdown: Quick snapshot (temp) | Save to library. Snapshots show a clock and TTL.
Noah: UI doable. Also add 'Promote to library' button on snapshots.
Liam: DB plan: add `kind` text default 'library' + optional `expires_at`. Backfill existing as library.
Priya: Telemetry: emit `save.kind` and `session_id`. Example: {"event":"console.save","kind":"snapshot","route":"r-9","model":"m-xl","session_id":"sess-7"}
Ava: Important: snapshots must not create routing pins or affect rollout policies. They are preview-only.
Noah: For Console lists: two sections and a filter toggle in quotas to include snapshots for debugging.
Liam: Rollout: feature-flagged, collect metrics for 2 weeks, then default on. Migration script + API change PR in progress.
deploy-bot: Spec doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/console-save-modes v0.3 pushed to staging.
Ava: Action items: Priya (copy + telemetry schema), Noah (UI mock + promote flow), Liam (API + migration + flag). Sync tomorrow 9:30am.
